verdict_reason: Diff on this file is only the package rename, but the metrics feature it owns is inert without @EnableScheduling, and the file carries 17 unused imports plus a Javadoc that describes beans and classes that do not exist

todos.issue: No @EnableScheduling anywhere in the app (grep of src finds none, Application.java has only @SpringBootApplication + @EnableConfigurationProperties), so EmfMetricsPublisher's @Scheduled(fixedRate = 60000) publishMetrics() never fires and no EMF metric is ever flushed to CloudWatch — MetricsConfigurationPropertiesTest asserts the annotation exists but nothing proves it runs
todos.fix: Add @EnableScheduling to MetricsConfig (the metrics @Configuration class) or to Application, and cover it with a context test asserting a ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor / TaskScheduler bean is present

todos.issue: 17 of the 23 imports are unused (Counter, DistributionSummary, FunctionCounter, FunctionTimer, Gauge, Measurement, Meter, Meter.Id, Meter.Type, Timer, CompositeMeterRegistry, DistributionStatisticConfig, PauseDetector, SimpleMeterRegistry, TimeUnit, ToDoubleFunction, ToLongFunction) — carried through the package rename; sonar java:S1128
todos.fix: Delete every import except CountedAspect, TimedAspect, MeterRegistry, Slf4j, Bean and Configuration

todos.issue: Class Javadoc is factually wrong for the code it sits on: it claims the class 'only provides a fallback SimpleMeterRegistry when metrics are disabled' (no such bean exists — only TimedAspect and CountedAspect) and points at EmfMetricsConfig and MetricsService, neither of which exists in the repo (grep finds them only in this comment)
todos.fix: Rewrite the Javadoc to describe the two AOP aspect beans and reference the real collaborators (EmfMetricsPublisher, application.yml management.metrics.*), or drop the ARCHITECTURE block
